每次调用现启动 agy：不多占内存，每次都要多等它启动的几秒。: agy starts when each call is made: no extra memory, and every call also waits the few seconds it takes to start.
默认。用过一次就提前启动好下一个：之后 10 分钟内的下一次调用少等几秒，第一次: Default. After a call, the next agy is started ahead of time: a call within the next 10 minutes waits a few seconds less; the first one waits as usual. It exits after 10 idle minutes and holds about 200 MB of memory while it waits.
打开 StudyHub 且启用 agy 时就备好一个，第一次也少等；开着软件就一: One is ready as soon as StudyHub is open with agy enabled, so the first call waits less too. It holds about 200 MB of memory for as long as the app is open (it is replaced every 10 minutes).

拿不准就保持「用过之后」：连续追问、带学、出题时省时间，停下 10 分钟后不再占: Not sure? Keep "After use": it saves time during follow-ups, tutoring and question generation, and frees the memory 10 minutes after you stop.
经常隔一阵问一两句（带学、帮我弄懂），内存宽裕：选「一直」。: You often ask a question or two with long gaps between (tutoring, "Help me understand") and have memory to spare: choose "Always".
省下的是 agy 的启动时间，模型思考和写回答的时间不变。在一台电脑上几次实测一: What is saved is agy's start-up time; the model still takes as long to think and write. Measured a few times on one computer with a one-word reply: about 11 to 20 seconds when started on demand, about 5 to 10 with one already waiting. The longer the answer, the smaller the share saved.
预热只是先把程序启动好，StudyHub 在你提问之前不向它发任何内容。每个备用: Pre-warming only starts the program; StudyHub sends it nothing before you ask. Each waiting process answers once, so one question never carries over into the next.
回答进行中会同时有一个在答、一个在备用，内存按两个算。改了模型或推理强度，备好的: While an answer is being written, one agy is answering and one is waiting, so count the memory twice. Changing the model or reasoning effort ends the waiting one, and a call that uses a different reasoning effort starts on demand. This only applies while the local agy is enabled.
如果一次要等半分钟以上，多半是 agy 里某个插件连接太慢：在命令行运行 agy: If one call takes more than half a minute, a plugin inside agy is usually slow to connect: run agy plugin list in a terminal and disable the ones you do not use.
